Post 1
📉 ASX 200 shed 161.50pts, -1.79% to 8,883.20, breaching its 20-day MA. Materials led the rout. Down 2.69% in five days, the index sits 4.45% below its 52-week high. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
⛏️ Materials cratered -3.86%, dragging the whole market lower. Utilities was the lone bright spot, +1.52%. Every other sector finished red. When miners break, the index breaks. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 3
TNE bucked the selloff hard — +8.86% to AUD 35.15. One software name outrunning a market-wide rout by that margin is a signal worth noting. #ASX #tech #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,753.42/oz offered little comfort to miners today as selling pressure overwhelmed any safe-haven bid. AUD/USD sits at 0.6736. #gold #ASX #ausbiz

Post 5
Watch Materials. Down 3.86% today, 2.69% on the week. Does the sector stabilise or does selling accelerate? Where do you see the floor — buyers step in here or lower? #ASX #mining #ausbiz
